title: Canonical bottom derived comparison on cycle classes
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; C has enough injectives and K-injective resolutions [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Let F:C\to D be additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive], I any integer-indexed cochain complex, and n\in\mathbf Z. Write h=(I.sc\ n).homologyData.left, so h.i:h.K\to I^n is the cycle kernel and h.\pi:h.K\to h.H is the homology quotient. Let J=F(I), H=H^n on D(D), P:complexes\to K be the homotopy quotient, Q:complexes\to D and Q_h:K\to D the localizations, and RF the right derived functor. Let e:H^n(J)\simeq H(Q_h(PJ)) be the inverse homotopy and derived homology factor comparisons. Let c:F(h.K)\to H^n(J) be the unique cycle lift of F(h.i), followed by the homology quotient of J. Let U:Q_h(F(P I))\to RF(Q_h(P I)) be the right-derived unit. Let q=RF(s_I\,p_I), where s_I:Q_h(P I)\simeq QI is the quotient/localization factor isomorphism and p_I:QI\to\tau_{\ge n}QI is the canonical lower-truncation projection [def-weil-t-structure]. There is an isomorphism b:H(RF(\tau_{\ge n}QI))\simeq F(h.H) such that c\,e\,H(U)\,H(q)\,b=F(h.\pi). No K-injectivity of I and no invertibility of H(RF(p_I)) is assumed. Composition is written in source-to-target order.

proof.text: Apply the proved underived lower-truncation cycle formula to obtain a:H^n(F(truncGE n I))≅F(H^n(I)), normalized on cycle classes.
Apply the bottom derived-unit bridge to obtain d:H^n(F(truncGE n I))≅H^n(RF(tauGE n QI)), compatible with the derived edge map.
Define b=d.symm composed with a. Rewrite the derived edge using the bridge; cancel d.hom followed by d.inv. The underived cycle formula gives F of the homology quotient.

theorem derived_lower_truncation_cycle_formula
    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v'} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} D]
    [EnoughInjectives C] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions C]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    let J := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n
    let e := ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors D (.up ℤ) n).app J).symm ≪≫
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh D n).app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).obj J)).symm
    let c := (J.sc n).liftCycles (F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.i) (by
      change F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.i ≫ F.map (I.sc n).g = 0
      rw [← F.map_comp, (I.sc n).homologyData.left.wi, F.map_zero]) ≫
      (J.sc n).homologyπ
    let U := F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)).obj I)
    let q := F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
      ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso C).hom.app I ≫
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ n).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
    ∃ b : H.obj (F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))) ≅
        F.obj (I.sc n).homologyData.left.H,
      c ≫ e.hom ≫ H.map U ≫ H.map q ≫ b.hom =
        F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.π
